query:
SELECT sync_generation,grant_generation,provider::text AS "provider!" FROM email_links l
        WHERE l.id=$1 AND l.is_sync_active AND l.disconnect_requested_at IS NULL
        AND (l.macro_id=$2 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM macro_user_links u WHERE u.link_id=l.id AND u.primary_macro_id=$2)) FOR UPDATE
